text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: The 'Hopeful Stakes', huh. Never thought I'd be running it with these kinds of feelings.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
That said—this race is a declaration of war.
A long-lasting one, directed at Tachyon.
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's pour everything from this past year into it!
Yeah, let's put everything from this past year into it!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Hell yeah!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Pocket-kun. You're looking well.
That's what matters most.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: "We both made it safely to this stage, didn't we?"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
But some didn't make it this far.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Even as I wished with all my might
to 'surpass you,' you know."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Is that so? But if you ask me,
that is also—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"I believe it's simply a consequence of vitality.
Most likely, it was unavoidable."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Whaaat!?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Running isn't the only thing
we've been doing all this time.
Yes, in other words—"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"—Survival of the fittest!
It's all about survival!"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Survival...?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed!
That's just how living creatures are in the first place.
Where does the starting line truly lie?"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
To live, and to survive.
If you don't survive, you'll never
become the fastest or the strongest.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: "I believe standing in a place like this can also be considered part of the race."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Is that so.
Well... whatever.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, I'm here, and
Tsuzuki isn't. In that case...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"All I gotta do is run.
Carrying her dream on my shoulders, too."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna slam it all into your face, for Tsuzuki's sake too!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Whoa, scary. Oh well.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Come along. I have matters of my own to attend to.
And I am in a bit of a hurry.

Agnes Tachyon wore a sneer.
Whether her eyes were truly fixed on Jungle Pocket or looking right through her, it was impossible to tell.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
(I don't know how far I can take this.
But if I see an opening, I'm taking it! No—)

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
(If there's no opening, I'll just pry one open!
I'll show 'em—how to slay a giant!)
